title: 数据中心建慢了：反而更推高通胀，算力成本才是关键
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: First of all, let's start with markets. Markets, OK. Where do you see interest rates going?
segments.zh: 首先从市场说起。市场方面，你认为利率会走向何方？

segments.en: I think there's a huge competition, as I wrote it in an op-ed last week, that there's huge competition for capital.
segments.zh: 我认为存在巨大的资本竞争，正如我上周在专栏文章中所写。

segments.en: We are starting to see the effect of this accumulative of our federal deficits in the US.
segments.zh: 我们开始看到美国联邦赤字累积的影响。

segments.en: We're starting to see the impact in other democracies as the scale of the deficits are becoming crowding out.
segments.zh: 其他民主国家也开始感受到影响，赤字规模正在产生挤出效应。

segments.en: We're at a time now where we're finally unlocking private capital.
segments.zh: 我们现在正处于终于释放私人资本的时刻。

segments.en: And so the competition or capital is as large as I've ever seen in my professional career.
segments.zh: 因此，资本竞争之激烈，是我职业生涯中从未见过的。

segments.en: If you listen to the hyperscalers in the United States alone, they're talking about a need for $7,000,000,000 to build out and to ensure that the United States is a leader in AI.
segments.zh: 仅听美国超大规模企业所言，他们谈到需要7万亿美元来建设并确保美国在人工智能领域的领导地位。

segments.en: That type of financing, that type of funding on top of the financing for the federal deficits is putting the term premium to be higher.
segments.zh: 这种融资，加上联邦赤字的融资，正在推高期限溢价。

segments.en: And I think we're going to see that term premium higher. In addition, there's a push and a pull in this.
segments.zh: 我认为我们将看到期限溢价走高。此外，这其中还有推力和拉力。

segments.en: If we don't build out these data sites, it is actually more inflationary, because the cost to compute is so high right now.
segments.zh: 如果我们不建设这些数据站点，实际上会更具通胀性，因为目前计算成本如此之高。

segments.en: And the faster we can build up more data centers and more compute we have, the faster we could bring down the cost.
segments.zh: 我们越快建成更多数据中心、积累更多算力，就能越快降低成本。

segments.en: So the irony in the short run, people are frightened of the impact of data centers in the community.
segments.zh: 所以短期内的讽刺在于，人们担心数据中心对社区的影响。
